newsitem.title: UK: Pillar Property buys two UK retail parks.
newsitem.headline: Pillar Property buys two UK retail parks.

text.p: Britain's Pillar Property Investments Plc said on Wednesday it had bought two retail park properties for a total of about 22 million stg.
Pillar said it bought Fleetsbridge Retail park in Poole from pension fund Hermes for 12 million stg and St. James Retail Park in Harrogate from Asda St. James Ltd for 9.8 million stg.
The acquisitions will raise Pillar's investment in retail parks to about 165 million stg, the company said in a statement. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
